prior_exposure: Official stock perpetual rules and download form field descriptions; no downloaded funding values inspected.
question: Do the official historical funding files identify the four intended USDT perpetuals, distinguish actual settlement from interest-rate assumptions, and support repeatable cost-accounting inputs?

sample_window.selection_rule: First complete day shown as default by the official download page; no outcome-based selection.

method: Download the official funding-rate file through the public historical-data page; record original filename, retrieval time, byte count and SHA-256.
Inspect archive and CSV types; reject API responses or absent files. Preserve source bytes locally; publish only authored observations and aggregate diagnostics pending redistribution permission.
Select exact exchange instrument identifiers for each product. Do not infer missing contracts or fill absent rows.
Sort settlement timestamps per contract; report row counts, duplicates, missing values, observed spacings, positive/negative/zero counts, and sum of realized funding-rate observations.
A sum of rates is a fixed-notional diagnostic only. It is not total funding in an actual position, net return, executable carry, predictive advantage or annualized yield.
Compare stock interest-rate term I=0 with actual observed funding. Any nonzero stock settlement refutes the claim that I=0 guarantees zero funding; missing observations keep it unknown.
Unknown fees, mark-price path, entry/exit costs, trade prices and quantity stay null; no profitability or readiness flag.
next_forward_work: Register a fully frozen observation-only or replay plan only after its necessary data and rules are verified. Do not treat this historical audit as forward validation.
